rows=[l.rstrip('\n').split('\t') for l in open('test') if l.strip()]
k=len(rows[0][0]); tab={r[0]:(r[1][0],r[1][1]) for r in rows}
preds={km:set() for km in tab}; succs={km:set() for km in tab}
missing=[]
for km,(l,r) in tab.items():
    if l!='F':
        p=l+km[:k-1]
        (preds[km].add(p) if p in tab else missing.append(('L',km,p)))
    if r!='F':
        s=km[1:]+r
        (succs[km].add(s) if s in tab else missing.append(('R',km,s)))
print("k",k,"nodes",len(tab))
print("missing endpoints:",missing)
print("outdeg dist", {d:sum(1 for v in succs.values() if len(v)==d) for d in range(0,4)})

print("sources(indeg0):",[n for n in tab if not preds[n]])
print("sinks(outdeg0):",[n for n in tab if not succs[n]])
# longest chain from each source
for s in [n for n in tab if not preds[n]]:
    p=[s]; c=s; seen={s}
    while succs[c] and len(p)<=len(tab):
        nx=next(iter(succs[c]))
        if nx in seen: p.append('CYCLE'); break
        c=nx; seen.add(c); p.append(c)
    print("from",s,"len",len(p),"ends",p[-1],"outdeg(end)",len(succs[p[-1]]) if p[-1] in succs else '?', "longest", len(p)==len(seen))

import random, sys
random.seed(int(sys.argv[2]))
n=int(sys.argv[1]); k=19
def rk(): return ''.join(random.choice('ACGT') for _ in range(k))
lines=[]
# a closed cycle: rotate a random k-mer cycle
base=rk(); cyc=[base]
for _ in range(500):
    cyc.append(cyc[-1][1:]+random.choice('ACGT'))
cyc_km=set(cyc)
for i,km in enumerate(cyc):
    nxt = cyc[(i+1)%len(cyc)]
    lines.append((km, ('F' if i==0 else cyc[i-1][k-1]), nxt[k-1]))
# a few linear chains with gaps
for _ in range(40):
    cur=rk(); chain=[cur]
    for _ in range(random.randint(1,60)):
        chain.append(chain[-1][1:]+random.choice('ACGT'))
    for i,km in enumerate(chain):
        le = 'F' if i==0 else chain[i-1][k-1]
        re = 'F' if i==len(chain)-1 else chain[i+1][k-1]
        if random.random()<0.1 and i>0: le='F'
        if random.random()<0.1 and i<len(chain)-1: re='F'

random.shuffle(lines)
seen=set(); out=[]
for km,le,re in lines:
    if km in seen: continue
    seen.add(km); out.append(f"{km}\t{le}{re}")
